heading: EXT. MANGROVE SWAMP - WRECKED FERRY - DUSK

units.text: EXT. MANGROVE SWAMP - WRECKED FERRY - DUSK
A half-sunk river ferry heeled over in brown water, its upper deck tilting among the roots.
Mosquitoes hang in the air like smoke.
Egrets lift from the branches as the light dims.
On the high side of the deck, three survivors huddle around a cooler.
MIRIAM OSEI-STEELE, forties, a nurse, kneels with a gash on her forearm bound in a torn shirt.
DESMOND "DEZ" LACROIX, fifties, a ferry mate, grips a boat hook.
And a young backpacker, FREYA NIEMI, twenties, sits with her knees up, a camera strap around her wrist.
Miriam lifts the cooler lid and counts the remaining water bottles, and Dez watches the tree line while Freya bites the skin around her thumb.
In the near channel, something large slides beneath the surface and the three of them go still as one, then look at each other, then at the water.
Nobody goes near the rail tonight.
units.name: MIRIAM

units.text: She's bleeding through.
units.name: DEZ

units.text: It's fine. It's fine.
units.name: FREYA

units.text: Freya, I need you to look at me. Not the water.
units.name: MIRIAM

units.text: Freya lifts her eyes.
Miriam peels back the shirt on her own arm, probes the cut, and winces.
Infected by morning if we don't clean it.
units.name: MIRIAM

units.text: We have the vodka.
units.name: DEZ

units.text: You are not wasting the vodka.
units.name: MIRIAM

units.text: It's for antiseptic.
units.name: DEZ

units.text: It's for emergencies.
units.name: MIRIAM

units.text: This is an emergency.
units.name: DEZ

units.text: This is a Tuesday.
units.name: MIRIAM

units.text: Dez laughs, startling himself.
Freya laughs, and then stops, because she is crying.
Miriam shifts to sit beside her, and Dez, awkward with the boat hook, drops it and puts a rough arm around Freya's shoulders from the other side.
The three of them rock in the dying light.
I wanted to see the herons.
units.name: FREYA

units.text: You saw the herons.
units.name: DEZ

units.text: I saw them leave.
units.name: FREYA

units.text: Above them, the first star appears over the canopy.
The cooler lid clatters shut in a breeze.
Miriam holds out the vodka bottle to Dez without looking at him, and he takes it.
He pours a little over her arm, and she hisses through her teeth, and he pours a little for himself.
